title: Skeleton Shimmer
description: Các khối khung xương có chung một vệt sáng chạy ngang liên tục, rồi nội dung thật (avatar, chữ, ảnh) hiện mờ dần đúng vào các vị trí đó.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-loading-skeleton-shimmer, written here): Card 180x132 r12: avatar circle r14, bars 90x8 and 56x6, image 152x44, bars 140x6 and 96x6 (r3). Highlight band moves linear 900 ms per pass across all skeleton boxes (one shared band, slight diagonal, grey → light → grey over 80 px at 45 %, clipped to the boxes); at 1.85-2.1 s the real content fades in at the same positions (avatar, two lines, image, two lines); 2.55-2.75 s back to skeleton. Params: pass (0.9 s, none) · band (80 px) · resolve (1.85 s, 0.25 s) · back (2.55 s). One shared highlight band clipped to every skeleton box.
